title: Clear wholeness leaves room for farewell
meaning: A directly explained connection can assemble fresh understanding while leaving room for farewell to an earlier shared picture.
text: An understandable whole picture sometimes entails parting with an earlier image. The Sun in the physical position of Ajna suggests directly explaining observations’ connection. The World in energy supports connecting understanding’s parts. Death in emotions experiences a familiar picture’s ending. A version that long united impressions can remain dear. Fresh meaning already has clear foundations while an emotional farewell to the familiar explanation is still continuing for both people.

Suppose you examine photographs from different trips and notice: “We photographed ordinary courtyards most often.” This detail connects unlike routes. **Clear wholeness can appear before farewell to an earlier image is complete.** Wanting assembled understanding reveals interest in places’ everyday life. A familiar account of seeking rare sights loses its leading role. You may miss it while still enjoying the photographs. Your view gains an explainable connection between images while each route retains personal details. Material already available to both people changes significance through attentive consideration together.

The risk is demanding complete rejection of the earlier account to finish the new picture quickly. Connecting parts distinguishes their place. Sights were interesting too although they do not explain everything. Your view can retain wholeness without emotional haste. Fresh understanding has foundations while regret remains an experience of change, neither cancelling the connection nor requiring earlier experience to be declared pointless.
